apihelp-oathauth-webauthn-summary: Module API-ga ee isgaarsiinta u dhexeysa adeegaha iyo macmiilka inta lagu jiro habka diiwaangelinta/xaqiijinta.
apihelp-oathauth-webauthn-param-func: Magaca shaqada la codsaday in la fuliyo.

apierror-oathauth-webauthn-invalid-crede: Xogta aqoonsigu waa mid aan ansax ahayn ama qaab dhismeedkeedu khaldan yahay.
apihelp-oathauth-webauthn-paramvalue-fun: Diiwaangeli aqoonsi WebAuthn cusub oo loogu talagalay isticmaalaha hadda jira.
apihelp-oathauth-webauthn-param-credenti: Jawaabta aqoonsiga WebAuthn ee biraawsarka soo diray oo lagu habeeyay JSON.
apihelp-oathauth-webauthn-param-friendly: Magac saaxiibtinimo oo loogu talagalay aqoonsiga cusub.
